description: Generate case studies with DISCOVERY MODE. If you have the full story, get a complete case study. If not, get interview questions to gather the story first.

challenge.description: The customer's challenge/problem (required for full mode)

interview_notes.description: Optional: Raw interview notes or transcript. Parsed into a case study when mode is 'full'

mode.description: full = generate case study (requires challenge/solution/results), discovery = generate interview questions to gather story

solution.description: How your product solved it (required for full mode)

name: case_study_generator
title: Case Study Generator
